issue.title: Fail to check setters in objects.

repository.name: standard
repository.description: 🌟 JavaScript Style Guide, with linter & automatic code fixer

issue.body:
Missing space before function parentheses.
Example:
  https://gist.github.com/anonymous/239cfd747eca6072c53e

Fails on "set variable (value) {}"

body: We probably just forgot to include getters/setters in the check.
This could be also a problem for generator functions.
@lo1tuma Seems to me space-before-function-parentheses should ignore anonymous generator functions and let generator-star handle that case?
